name: Yamanaka Castle
description: Yamanaka Castle was a Hojo-clan fortress guarding the Hakone pass into the Kanto plain. Its dry moats and earthworks were the site of the 1590 battle against Toyotomi forces and are well preserved as a national historic site.
highlights: Hojo guard castle of Hakone pass
notes: Free open-air site on the Tokaido route; a short climb from the parking area.
businessHours: Open access (castle ruins; see official site for seasonal hours)
openingHoursJa: 城跡は自由に見学可（季節により開館時間が変わる施設あり）

ja.name: 山中城
ja.description: 箱根の関所を守った後北条氏の城。1590年の小田原攻めで激戦地となり、深い空堀が残る国史跡です。
ja.notes: 無料の野外遺構。東海道沿いで駐車場から少し登ります。
